## getPendingConfirmations

Get Pending Confirmations. `GET /double-opt-in/pending`

Get list of pending email confirmations

Shows all contacts awaiting email confirmation for this tenant. Useful for admin dashboard to track conversion rates.

```php
$result = $sendseven->doubleOptIn()->getPendingConfirmations();
```

## resendConfirmationEmail

Resend Confirmation Email. `POST /double-opt-in/resend`

Resend confirmation email for pending subscription

If the original token has expired, a new token will be generated. If the original token is still valid, the same confirmation link will be resent.

```php
$sendseven->doubleOptIn()->resendConfirmationEmail(email: 'email');
```

- Scopes: `email:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$email` | `string` | yes | Email address to resend confirmation to |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Double%20Opt-In/resend_confirmation_email_api_v1_double_opt_in_resend_post)

## sendConfirmationEmail

Send Confirmation Email. `POST /double-opt-in/send`

Send double opt-in confirmation email to contact

This endpoint: 1. Creates or finds contact by email 2. Creates pending subscription record 3. Generates secure confirmation token 4. Sends confirmation email with link

```php
$result = $sendseven->doubleOptIn()->sendConfirmationEmail(email: 'email');
```

- Scopes: `email:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$email` | `string` | yes | Email address to confirm |
| `$listId` | `?string` | no | Optional list ID to subscribe to |
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Subscription category (newsletter, promotions, updates) |
| `$ipAddress` | `?string` | no | IP address of requester for audit trail |
| `$userAgent` | `?string` | no | User agent for audit trail |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `DoubleOptInSend`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Double%20Opt-In/send_confirmation_email_api_v1_double_opt_in_send_post)
